aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` lets the model choose.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. An explicit duration is required to place the end frame.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.

start_image_url.title: Start Image URL
start_image_url.description: URL of the image used as the first frame of the video (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The text prompt describing the video you want to generate.

end_image_url.title: End Image URL
end_image_url.description: URL of the image used as the last frame of the video (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. `1080p`, `1440p` (2K) and `2160p` (4K) are finished by the video upsampler; exact dimensions depend on the aspect ratio.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed used for the generation.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
